card.name: Start of the word concomitant
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word "concomitant" (Con or con), split before "comitant". It appears in drug interaction sections, often right after a drug or class heading.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Con
modes.description: Capitalized start of "Concomitant" opening an interaction statement after a drug heading.
